lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，像被水推着。
lines.en: I shuffle along as if pushed by water.

lines.zh: 石雕的膝盖发出摩擦声。
lines.en: My stone knees grind.
My feet drag a wet trail.
I raise my head and study the path.
Slow, but I do not stop.
The shells on me knock together.
The damp moves with me.

lines.zh: 半张脸是石头的，看不见表情。
lines.en: Half my face is stone, unreadable.
The soil darkens where I pass.
My arms hang, dripping.
Going around a rock costs me effort.
I walk along the shoreline.
My foot crushes a dry shell.
One step, two. I lost count.
My shadow drags a wet mark.

lines.zh: 我从水里出来，还带着水。
lines.en: I came out of the water, and still carry it.
Standing like a small statue.
Water drips from my chin.
I watch the water in the distance.
Still enough to pass for stone.
The wind dries one side of me.

lines.zh: 潮退得太远，我站着等它回。
lines.en: The tide has drawn far out; I stand waiting for it to return.
Shells cling to my skin.
One joint moves, one click.
I know this beach well.
A crab crosses by my foot.
I do not need much breath.
Water enters my seams and leaves.
Standing long, my feet sink in sand.
Sun on the stone feels warm.
Have you come to see the sea too?
Half my face is stone.
Stand off to one side.
I am counting your footprints.

lines.zh: 你身上一点水汽都没有。
lines.en: There is not a trace of damp on you.
I am not fast, but I am patient.
This is a shoreline, not a road.
Tilt your ear this way; the sea is speaking.
I know the taste of salt.
Stand here and you will be soaked.
The stone has cracked.
Water leaks from the crack.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚陷进沙里。
lines.en: Half a step back, my feet in sand.
A shell falls off me.
It hurts, but my reaction is slow.
I can still stand like this.
Another crack in half my face.
Water runs down mixed with sand.
I steady myself with a hand.
This body is sturdy.
Hand me that water, quickly.
Tip that bucket over.
Salt. I want salt.
I come from the sea. I am not picky.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在你手里拍尾巴。
lines.en: That fish is still slapping its tail in your hand.
Put it on that stone.
I can smell the tide.
Do not take it away. I am watching.
One small mouthful is enough.
The damp on you counts too.
The part you touched is stone.
I give ground more slowly.
You knocked yourself backward.
Do not push me. I would topple.
Let us each take a side.
You stepped in my wet trail.
I have shells. They scratch.
I have finally steadied myself.
That bump does not concern me.
Any closer and I follow you.
My face is stone.
My kin in the sea suit me better.

lines.zh: 等下一次涨潮，这些话就冲没了。
lines.en: The next high tide will wash these words away.

lines.zh: 石头磨出来的嗓子，说不出软话。
lines.en: A throat ground from stone cannot manage soft words.
Let us speak when the water rises.
I am too wet for that.

lines.zh: 我只是一具量产的身体。
lines.en: I am only a mass-produced body.
Ask someone else about that.
The shells on me would get in the way.
The tide has gone out.
A shell. I keep it.
Stone fingers cannot grip.
I pinch it with both hands.
This thing on the ground is salty.
I wedge it into a seam.
Water drips as I bend.
This one is dead. I drop it.
Let me see what this piece is.
Something fell from you.

lines.zh: 这东西是你的，我递回你手里。
lines.en: This belongs to you, so I hand it back into your hand.
You are blocking the tide's path.
You are like a dry stone.
I will drive you toward the water.
Do not think me slow.

lines.zh: 你挪一米，我这具身体跟一米。
lines.en: You shift a metre and this body of mine shifts one too.
This shore belongs to the sea.

lines.zh: 沙上那串脚印，我印在心里。
lines.en: That line of prints in the sand is pressed into my mind.
I press in an inch at a time.
The water will arrive before I do.
You are alive. Good.

lines.zh: 我不跑，就这么一步一步移。
lines.en: I don't run; I simply shift forward, step by step.
Water at your feet.
I can barely hear your breathing.
Back further and you enter the sea.
I am dripping.
I wait for you to tire.
Stone knows no fatigue.
Turn away, and I follow.

lines.zh: 一步、两步，我数到第七步。
lines.en: One step, two — I count up to the seventh.
Sand underfoot makes it harder.
A stone hand comes down.
I give him a hard shove.
A shell cuts his hand.

lines.zh: 石手落下去，力道只用了三成。
lines.en: My stone hand comes down with only a third of its force.
Water splashes into his eyes.
I wrap his legs.
He retreats, and I follow slowly.
Stone strength, slowly applied.
My movements are clumsy.
I draw back and stand.

lines.zh: 浅滩的水只到我膝盖，我起了。
lines.en: The shallows only reach my knees as I stand up.
The water on me has not dried.
A mass-produced body.
The shoreline needs a guard.
I step out; sand everywhere.
This body is not quite human.
Who lit a lamp on the shore?
The tide set me down.
I raise my head and look around.
I have come up from the shallows.
Fire makes the stone hot.
On falling, the shells scatter.
In water, I am at ease.
The blast throws up wet sand.
The arrow strikes stone and bounces.
This light passes into the stone.
Too long from water, I dry out.
Current spreads through the water.
The sand is pulled away, and I with it.
